title: [PEPPOL] Handle unknown persisted PEPPOL format values
summary: The PEPPOL 3.0 Format enum now handles persisted format values that become unknown when their declaring extension is uninstalled, preventing runtime errors and prompting users to select an available format.
key_points: Added unknown-value mappings for all interfaces implemented by the PEPPOL Format enum
Created a handler that guides users to select an available format when encountering unknown formats
Added test coverage for validation and conversion of persisted unknown ordinal values
quote: A PEPPOL format enum ordinal can remain in the persisted PEPPOL 3.0 Setup after the enum extension that declared it is uninstalled.
